"More" (1998) -- One of the best short animated films I have ever seen.
Absolutely hit me in the face when I saw this over 10 years ago.

I remember this as well. Even with such a simple message - you can neither buy, nor manufacture happiness - it's still very impactful, and beautifully made. I wonder... was he better off before or after his success?

That's a pretty complex question, but in my opinion he realizes that what he loved was gone. Whether that is better or worse, I could never say. I will say that the animation team and director did a great job expressing his final expression. To me he is experiencing despair. And for a long time after my initial viewing, my attempts to search the title housed the word despair.

Nothing brings a community together like helping people!

Oxfam is a wonderful charity that i have supported for years. They have a program where you can donate a goat ($50 each) to a rural farmer or farming community. The goats provide good sources of sustainable food and income such as cheese and milk and their dung is good fertilizer for rural farmers. They are easy to take care of and eat most anything so they're an ideal livestock. When they get older and after they have provided a few kids (hehe) yes they will be eaten. This is a much better way to send aid as opposed to food, since these people are primarily farmers themselves if direct food aid is sent they have harder times selling their own crops. This way they can actually make a better living and sustain themselves.

https://www.oxfamamericaunwrapped.com/gifts/donate-goat/

I think this would be a great way to help build the Voat community, draw people to talk about Voat, and help people. We could make it an official, yearly event to come together as a community and do some good.
